name: GLEIF LEI API
tagline: Global Legal Entity Identifier lookup for standardized entity identity
description: Public REST API from the Global Legal Entity Identifier Foundation providing free access to the Global LEI Index. Lookup LEI records, search legal entities by name or attributes, and retrieve relationship data for KYC, AML, and regulatory compliance workflows.

auth.details: No authentication required. Public open data endpoints; rate limits may apply per IP.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free public access; no paid plans published for the open API

use_cases: look up a legal entity by LEI code
search LEIs by legal entity name
verify entity status for KYC/AML checks
retrieve parent/child relationship data for corporate hierarchy
enrich compliance records with standardized LEI identity fields
